summary: Replaces an empty Nest API and static metrics with a connected PostgreSQL worker directory, bounded search/pagination and active company selection.
Adds salted scrypt sign-in, signed short-lived tokens, request-time account/tenant checks and tenant-scoped access for three operations roles.
Implements versioned profile CRUD, guarded lifecycle transitions, read-only terminated history and deletion restricted to unlinked drafts.
Commits worker changes and minimal audit records together, with database email uniqueness and composite company/tenant ownership constraints.
Preserves failed/stale UI drafts, confirms destructive actions and current-data replacement, clears workspace state on sign-out and renders names literally.
Provides a fresh migration, repeatable non-overwriting seed, corrected setup and scope documentation, isolated PostgreSQL/Chromium harness and nine detailed CRUD learning documents.
Validates 29 real-database API tests, eight Chromium workflows, both builds, type checks, frontend lint, two seed runs and two reviewed screenshots.

checks.command: Prisma validate/generate/migrate; API typecheck; 29 Jest/PostgreSQL integration cases; both builds; frontend typecheck/lint; repeated seed; eight Chromium scenarios
checks.environment: Node 22.16.0; Prisma 5.22.0; PostgreSQL 18.1; Playwright 1.60.0; Chromium 148; helper-owned databases and browser contexts

limits: Implemented worker operations slice only; company maintenance, worker self-service, global platform admin access and other EOR workflows remain unimplemented schema/roadmap material.
Initial migration is for an empty database; no existing personal database was migrated. Legacy bcrypt demo credentials require an explicit migration or fresh learning database.
Local authentication has no MFA, refresh sessions or distributed throttling; request-time revocation checks do not cancel already executing transactions.
No create-idempotency receipts, notification outbox, deployment/load/crash/power-loss validation or full accessibility certification. Narrow tables use contained horizontal scrolling.
Docker configuration was updated for loopback access but could not be run because its daemon was unavailable.
